blocks.note: Select questo or quello from discourse distance, then inflect the adjective or pronoun for gender, number, and the following sound; the hygiene gate excludes every synthetic matching item and the one judgment-dependent translation.
Use questo and quello without a following noun for things, people, propositions, unchanged situations, and lexicalized discourse responses.
Transform sentences with formal human demonstratives, expressions of kind or degree, and point-versus-area place demonstratives.
Distinguish identity and emphasis with stesso from reflexive reference, independent action, personal viewpoint, and mere similarity with uguale.
